resolved_review_findings.resolution: All six graph temporal inputs are parsed once into timezone-aware UTC values. EvidenceObservationV2 persists them through null-safe Cypher datetime(parameter) conversion on create, required unknown or invalid time fails closed, optional unknown remains null, and no current-time substitution exists.

Only write_mode=legacy plus provenance=legacy_explicit enters the aggregate legacy MERGE. V2, unknown-provenance, incomplete, invalid and quarantined inputs are rejected before entity/relation work with zero write calls and compact stable rejection codes/counts.

Canonical Stage03 materialized_at or ingested_at provenance is carried without a now fallback, required and normalized for temporal V2, persisted as a Neo4j DateTime on create, and left unchanged on idempotent retry.
